//: Copy to .claude/cerberus.json in your project. Every key is optional.
//watch_paths: Narrow marking to these directories. Empty or absent means anywhere in the project.
//source_extensions: What counts as executable source. Extension-based rather than path-based, because layouts differ per project but 'a file of source code' travels.
//ignore_patterns: Never mark these. Tests are excluded on purpose: a test edit is not what the two stages verify.
//claim_patterns: Regexes that count as claiming readiness. REPLACES the defaults rather than extending them, so a project can turn the gate down without editing the hooks. If the gate cries wolf, narrow this — do not delete the hook.
//marker: Where the pending marker lives, relative to the project root.
//verification: Declares the delivery boundary so Stage 2 is a fact rather than a guess. artifact_kind is one of: service, library, cli, chart, migration, model-boundary, plugin.

stage2: # whatever crosses the boundary for this artifact, e.g.:
verification.notes: Free text the agent should know: where the dev environment is, which account to use, what must never be touched.
